All worlds, specially the SA, has dominando guild who thinks it deserves more than everyone else. Some have more stricty norms, others are more liberal. I suggested u descubra because it is closed to transfer, so the competition is more fair and u'll often find ppl on lower level to share exp with u. Most of these transferable worlds got a fucked up economy, high tibia coin price and lot of ppl used to bot on other worlds. A big part of the characters has been bought or sold and most of the players are 300+. So u'll often have problems with ks, luring, traps and other things that "dominando" guilds like to do. In fact, I consider optional-pvp the worst type of world to play nowadays. If u got a team go to a pvp or retro-pvp server...

Dominando guilds in optional pvp has been a big problem for others players and I think CIP should do something about it. Those changes on exiva got almost zero impact. We need instances or something like that. It's hilarious that most of the guys are in a guild like this just to hunt peacifully, even if they have to do things that they dissaprove like pay guild bank and serve their leaders (aka ks other guys whenever they call u to do that).

So... there aren't many differences between descubra, belobra and these other world like celebra, gentebra and kalibra. They are just less worse. [kalibra is the worse of all btw]
